ud5.8:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Veḷuvane Kalandakanivāpe.
ud5.8:1.3: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Ānando tadah' uposathe pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram ādāya Rājagahaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi.
ud5.8:2.1: addasā kho Devadatto āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ Rājagahe piṇḍāya carantaṃ,
ud5.8:2.2: disvāna yena āyasmā Ānando ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ Ānandaṃ etad avoca:
ud5.8:2.3: ajjatagge dān' āhaṃ āvuso Ānanda aññatr' eva bhagavatā aññatra bhikkhusaṃghā uposathaṃ karissāmi saṅghakammāni cā 'ti.
ud5.8:3.1: atha kho āyasmā Ānando Rājagahe piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto yena bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi,
ud5.8:3.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Ānando bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
ud5.8:4.1: idh' āhaṃ bhante pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram ādāya Rājagahaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisiṃ.
ud5.8:4.2: addasā kho maṃ bhante Devadatto Rājagahe piṇḍāya carantaṃ,
ud5.8:4.3: disvāna yen' āhaṃ ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā maṃ etad avoca:
ud5.8:4.5: ajja bhante Devadatto saṅghaṃ bhindissati uposathañ ca karissati saṅghakammāni cā 'ti.
ud5.8:5.1: atha kho bhagavā etam atthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi:
